items.title: John LaPorta interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996

ctx.x: How did the Jazz Composers Orchestra come about?

Bill Kass, I don’t know whether you know that name or not, was editor for Metronome Magazine. Metronome Magazine is now defunct but it was the parallel of Down Beat during those years, was a very good friend of Mingus, and they talked about it and Bill kind of organized it. And the idea of it was that it was to be player-writer members. And this is what it was essentially. And we were together for about two and a half years. We put together three major concerts and they were well received by the musicians in New…
nothing would come out of the taping of the concert, so it was just prohibitive in terms of the cost of it. So it was never recorded, which was a shame.
